blocking_findings.summary: Persisted monthly forecast records omit two required reproducibility fields.
evidence: The monthly-backtest contract requires every forecast record to include universe manifest hash and materialization timestamps.
api/routes/analyze.py::_compact_monthly_forecast retains universe_manifest_hash and feature_materialized_at in the API object.
api/routes/analyze.py::_forecast_row does not place either field at row level or inside forecast_payload, and feature_snapshot_id is always null.
An independent offline counterprobe supplied both fields to _forecast_row and observed universe_manifest_hash_persisted=False and feature_materialized_at_persisted=False.
The QA persistence test verifies returns and narrative exclusion but does not assert preservation of these required provenance values.
blocking_findings.contract_violation: The required reproducibility fields in .codex/contracts/monthly-backtest-contract.md are not preserved in the monthly_forecasts storage record.

blocking_findings.summary: backtest_runs.reproducibility_hash is not the canonical hash over the declared immutable reproduction inputs.
evidence: The data-schema contract requires a unique reproducibility hash over universe, cutoff schedule, folds, costs, dataset, feature, model, action-policy, and code/config versions.
api/routes/backtest.py::_reproducibility_hash returns the Stage 09 manifest report_hash whenever it is a valid 64-character hex value.

Stage 09 computes report_hash over manifest, folds, records, metrics and leakage output; its manifest contains run_id but does not contain the Stage 10B persisted model_version, code_version or config_version.

An independent offline counterprobe ran identical fixture/configuration with two run IDs and observed same_inputs_different_run_report_hash_equal=False, proving the reused hash is coupled to run identity.
The same probe changed model_version and config_version while retaining report_hash and observed identity_version_mutation_changes_persisted_hash=False.
The existing backtest persistence test checks only shape/status and does not verify canonical hash sensitivity or exclusion of run_id/output values.
blocking_findings.contract_violation: The persisted unique value is an output/report identity, not the required versioned reproduction-input identity defined by .codex/contracts/data-schema-contract.md.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Backtest jobs are process-local and frontend validation is static.
non_blocking_findings.assessment: Both limitations are explicitly disclosed, deterministic behavior is tested, and neither contradicts the current Stage 10B contract.

required_rework.required: In the existing schema, preserve universe_manifest_hash and feature_materialized_at inside the compact monthly_forecasts.forecast_payload, or use already-authorized dedicated columns if they exist. Add exact persistence tests asserting both values survive and remain compact. Do not apply or change migrations.

Build reproducibility_hash from one canonical input-only object containing universe version/hash, cutoff schedule, fold definitions, transaction-cost policy, dataset/feature/model/action-policy versions, model variants, and code/config versions. Exclude run_id, metrics, predictions and other outputs. Add tests proving identical inputs with different run IDs produce the same hash and that changing each version/config identity changes it. Preserve report_hash separately as artifact identity.

Persistence success/failure disposition is nonfatal and emits stable codes only.
Backtest local lifecycle has current identity, measured latency and stable failure code.
Privacy, raising-sink and concurrent API telemetry isolation tests pass.
